executiveSummary: Today's sweep pushed the topic further toward platform engineering and AI-assisted delivery. The biggest material change is a broader Hiberus cluster on the Wrocław board, now spanning AI Platform Engineering, AI Process Automation, and AI & Automation roles. I also found fresh Wrocław hybrid signals from Rigby and Grid Dynamics, plus a new product-oriented ALTIMI ML role. Sii still appears live in the current public sources, but I did not see the previous Expires tomorrow cue in today's checks.

opportunities.uncertainty: Board titles are closely related and may shuffle across mirrors.

opportunities.uncertainty: The board and official site can move independently, so the shelf life is still worth watching.

changes: Hiberus moved from a two-role signal to a broader AI Platform Engineering / AI Process Automation family on the Wrocław board.
New Wrocław hybrid engineering signals appeared from Rigby and Grid Dynamics.
ALTIMI added a new product-oriented ML role on the Wrocław board.
Sii remains visible, but the current sources do not reproduce the prior near-expiry cue.
risks: Board-first titles can shift, split, or disappear between heartbeats.
Salary currency and employment type still vary across board mirrors and employer pages, especially for Rigby and some Wrocław board cards.
Hiberus titles appear in multiple closely related variants, so deduplication should stay strict.
recommendedActions: Re-check Hiberus, Rigby, Grid Dynamics, and ALTIMI on the next heartbeat for expiry and salary drift.
Keep Sii on watch, but only treat it as an expiry candidate if the board mirror shows that cue again.
